描述_EN: a close examination of the object and scientific tests have revealed that the lid is an original production dated about 500-400 bc, while the bottom half of the vessel and the lid handle were made in the 14th century or slightly earlier. this elegant example from the later eastern zhou dynasty (771-221 bc) uses gold inlays to produce a delicate pattern of stylised interlacing dragons. this evidence supports the theory that this piece was conceived for an antiquarian or collector of the song (960-1279) or yuan (1279-1368) dynasty, following the taste for archaic objects developed during the song period. this type of vessel, called a dou in chinese, was routinely cast during the western zhou dynasty (1050-771 bc) for use in ceremonies and death rituals.
描述_ZN: 通过对该物品的仔细检查和科学测试发现，盖子是公元前500-400年的原始产品，而容器的下半部分和盖子的把手是在14世纪或稍早的时候制作的。 这个来自东周晚期（公元前771-221年）的优雅的例子使用黄金镶嵌来产生一个精致的风格化交错的龙的图案。 这一证据支持了这一理论，即这一作品是为宋朝（960-1279）或元朝（1279-1368）的古董商或收藏家构思的，遵循了宋朝时期形成的对古物的品味。 这种类型的容器，在中国被称为斗，在西周时期（公元前1050-771年）经常被铸造，用于仪式和死亡仪式。
